cause.match: Match each disease to the microbe or parasite that causes it.
cause.reverse: Which of these diseases is caused by {value}?

rows.label: tuberculosis
rows.description: infectious disease caused by the bacterium Mycobacterium tuberculosis
rows.hook: was historically nicknamed consumption and mainly attacks the lungs

rows.label: COVID-19
rows.hook: sparked a worldwide pandemic that led to lockdowns and mask wearing

rows.label: smallpox
rows.hook: is the only human illness ever wiped out worldwide, thanks to vaccination

rows.label: anthrax
rows.description: infection caused by Bacillus anthracis bacteria
rows.hook: is a bacterial infection mostly caught from livestock, once called woolsorters' disease

rows.label: Lyme disease
rows.description: infectious disease caused by Borrelia bacteria, spread through the bite of blacklegged ticks
rows.hook: is spread by tick bites and often starts with a bull's-eye shaped rash

rows.label: typhoid fever
rows.description: bacterial infectious disorder contracted by consumption of food or drink contaminated with Salmonella typhi. This disorder is common in developing countries and can be treated with antibiotics.
rows.hook: spreads through contaminated food and water and is linked to the infamous cook Mary Mallon

rows.label: diphtheria
rows.hook: forms a thick grey coating in the throat and is prevented by the D in the DTP vaccine

rows.label: herpes zoster
rows.description: viral disease caused by the Varicella zoster virus

rows.label: chickenpox
rows.hook: gives children itchy blisters all over and is now largely prevented by a vaccine

rows.label: poliomyelitis
rows.hook: was beaten back worldwide by vaccines from Jonas Salk and Albert Sabin

rows.label: cholera
rows.description: bacterial infection of the small intestine
rows.hook: spreads through dirty drinking water and was traced to a London pump by John Snow

rows.label: plague
rows.description: specific contagious and frequently fatal human disease caused by Yersinia pestis
rows.hook: spread by fleas on rats and swept medieval Europe as the Black Death

rows.label: tetanus
rows.description: bacterial infection characterized by muscle spasms
rows.hook: is also called lockjaw and is prevented by a booster shot after a rusty nail scare

rows.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
rows.description: connective tissue cancer, common among early AIDS patients

rows.label: scarlet fever
rows.hook: gives children a sandpapery red rash and a bumpy strawberry-looking tongue

rows.label: giardiasis
rows.description: parasitic disease of humans and other mammals

rows.label: severe acute respiratory syndrome
rows.hook: was a coronavirus outbreak that began in southern China and alarmed many countries
